{{Main|Plymouth City Council elections}}

The '''2026 Plymouth City Council election''' was held on 7 May 2026, alongside the [[2026 United Kingdom local elections|other local elections across the United Kingdom]] held on the same day, to elect 19 of 57 members of [[Plymouth City Council]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Dates of upcoming polls {{!}} PLYMOUTH.GOV.UK |url=https://www.plymouth.gov.uk/dates-upcoming-polls |access-date=2026-01-27 |website=Plymouth City Council |language=en}}</ref>

Changes 2024–2026:
*May 2025: Carol Ney (Labour) and Zoe Reilly (Labour) leave party to sit as independents; [[Dylan Tippetts]] (Labour) joins Liberal Democrats<ref>{{cite news |last1=Davis |first1=Miles |title=Three Plymouth city councillors quit Labour |url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cm23e85elg2o |access-date=2 February 2026 |work=BBC News |date=19 May 2025}}</ref>
*February 2026: Steve Ricketts (Independent) joins Reform<ref>{{cite news |last1=Stephenson |first1=Alison |title=Plymouth's first Reform councillor won't resign over defection |url=https://www.plymouthherald.co.uk/news/plymouth-news/plymouths-first-reform-councillor-wont-10871236 |access-date=7 May 2026 |work=Plymouth Live |date=17 March 2026 |language=en}}</ref>
*March 2026: Carol Ney (Independent) joins Reform<ref>{{cite news |last1=Stephenson |first1=Alison |title=Second councillor joins Reform ahead of election |url=https://www.plymouthherald.co.uk/news/plymouth-news/second-councillor-joins-reform-ahead-10925351 |access-date=7 May 2026 |work=Plymouth Live |date=20 April 2026 |language=en}}</ref>

==Summary==

===Background===
In [[2024 Plymouth City Council election|2024]], the [[Labour Party (UK)|Labour Party]] retained control of the council.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Clark |first=Daniel |date=2024-05-03 |title=Plymouth City Council local elections 2024 results in full |url=https://www.plymouthherald.co.uk/news/plymouth-news/plymouth-city-council-local-elections-9262275 |access-date=2026-01-27 |website=Plymouth Live |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news |title=Plymouth result - Local Elections 2024 |url=https://www.bbc.com/news/election/2024/england/councils/E06000026 |access-date=2026-01-27 |work=BBC News |language=en-GB}}</ref> In 2025, it was reported that the elections were potentially being cancelled.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2025-12-19 |title=Elections may be cancelled in Plymouth and Exeter |url=https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/ceq1p2pz3gyo |access-date=2026-01-27 |website=www.bbc.com |language=en-GB}}</ref>
